items.title: Truck sales
items.body: New and used International trucks, IC Bus and Capacity yard trucks, plus the truck configurator and financing.

items.title: Parts counter
items.body: Genuine OEM and all-makes parts for trucks and trailers, with online ordering and delivery across the Tampa Bay area.

items.title: Service & trailer bays
items.body: Factory-trained technicians, dedicated trailer repair bays, DOT inspections, alignment, and mobile service dispatch.

items.title: In-store shopping
items.body: In-store shopping and curbside pickup, with after-hours service coverage through Certified Fleet.

items.title: Trailer Sales — 6020 E Adamo Dr
items.body:
New and used Hyundai Translead and Globe Trailers share the Tampa address, open 8 AM – 5 PM Monday through Friday. Talk to a member of our sales team about available inventory, financing, or to schedule an in-person appointment.

Phone: (813) 621-1331 · Fax: 813-628-0527

items.title: Aftermarket Parts — 7105 E 6th Ave
items.body:
Minutes from the dealership, our Tampa aftermarket facility handles truck equipment repair, roll off cable repair, hydraulic repairs, body installations, liftgates and frame modifications, open 7 AM – 4 PM Monday through Friday.

Phone: (813) 627-3282

values.heading: Other Sun State locations.
values.body: Ready to find the right commercial trucks for your business? Visit us at our convenient locations across Central and Southwest Florida.

items.q: Where is Sun State International in Tampa?
items.a: Sun State International Trucks, LLC. is at 6020 Adamo Drive, Tampa, FL 33619, just off Adamo Drive east of downtown Tampa. Phone (813) 621-1331, fax 813-628-0527.
Sales and parts are open 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM Monday through Friday and 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM Saturday. Service is open 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM Monday through Friday. Closed Sunday.

items.q: Is after-hours service available in Tampa?
items.a: Yes. After hours service runs 8:00 PM to 5:00 AM via Certified Fleet at (863) 880-2206.

items.q: Do you rent equipment from the Tampa location?
Can I buy trailers at the Tampa location?
items.a: Yes. Sun State Trailers Trailer Sales shares the 6020 Adamo Drive address and is open 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday through Friday, selling new and used Hyundai Translead and Globe Trailers. Call (813) 621-1331.

items.q: Where is the Tampa aftermarket facility?
items.a: Sun State Aftermarket Parts is a few minutes away at 7105 East 6th Ave, Tampa, FL 33619, open 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Monday through Friday. Call (813) 627-3282.

values.heading: Ready to get on the road?
values.body: Contact us to explore our trucks and experience nothing less than the dedicated care you deserve.
